preconditions.description: The grid dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(grid_lines) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in grid_lines)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n lines, each with exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '.X' for row in grid_lines for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either '.' (unmarked) or 'X' (marked).

preconditions.expression: all(grid_lines[r][c] != 'X' for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if r == 0 or r == n-1 or c == 0 or c == m-1)
preconditions.description: No marked cells ('X') are adjacent to the edge of the grid.

postconditions.description: The first line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'NO' or (len(output_lines) == n + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == m for line in output_lines[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the output contains exactly n additional lines, each with m space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'NO' or all(int(output_lines[r][c]) in (1, 4) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid_lines[r][c] == '.')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', every unmarked cell ('.') in the output grid contains either 1 or 4.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'NO' or all(int(output_lines[r][c]) % 5 == 0 for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid_lines[r][c] == 'X')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', every marked cell ('X') in the output grid contains a multiple of 5.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'NO' or all(int(output_lines[r][c]) == sum(int(output_lines[nr][nc]) for nr, nc in [(r-1,c), (r+1,c), (r,c-1), (r,c+1)] if 0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < m and grid_lines[nr][nc] == '.') for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid_lines[r][c] == 'X')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', every marked cell ('X') contains the sum of the numbers in all adjacent unmarked cells.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0] == 'NO' or (output_lines[0] == 'YES' and any(int(output_lines[r][c]) in (1, 4) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid_lines[r][c] == '.') or all(grid_lines[r][c] == 'X' for r in range(n) for c in range(m)))
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', a valid assignment exists satisfying all constraints; otherwise, no such assignment exists.
